ITEM 1 | Finely chopped dark green leafy greens with ruffled, curly edges and a matte-to-slightly-glossy sheen, coated in a pale creamy dressing; occupies roughly 30% of the plate in an irregular mound about 13 cm across, piled 2-3 cm high and loosely clumped, sitting off-center on the right side of a white square plate | 150

ITEM 2 | Pale off-white cheese in a thin irregular flake/shard about 2.5 cm across and 0.5 cm thick, slightly translucent edges with a crumbly, granular surface, sitting on top of the greens near the center of the mound | 8

ITEM 3 | Small scattered pale yellow-white crumbs and shreds of hard grated cheese, finely granular with a dry matte surface, mixed through the greens around the upper middle of the mound | 5

ITEM 4 | Thin flat pale tan shaving of hard cheese about 3 cm long and 1 cm wide, slightly curled, with a smooth dry surface, lying at the lower edge of the greens on the plate | 4

ITEM 5 | Small dark brown bits, roughly 1 cm across, with a dry, slightly crinkled surface, tucked at the right edge of the greens | 3
